name: Fang
source:
The first person to really intrigue Anon, circumstances seems to push them together. Moody and aggressive on good days, beneath it all lies a young adult woman trying to find something in her life to no avail. The only thing Fang knows for certain is her own love of playing music.

[From [url=https://snootgame.xyz/characters.html]official website[/url]]
